{{Quote|Roof? Not the personal vehicles hangar?|Wes Janson|<ref name="sc">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Sivantlie Base''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that used to be a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] catering to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucrats. The building had an officers lounge<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> and [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] that carried people to the personal vehicles [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] or the roof.<ref name="sc" />

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] the planet, the building was used as a temporary base for military personnel awaiting new orders or transfer to a new location. The [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]] was assigned there before heading out on a [[Hunt for Zsinj|mission]] to hunt [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="if" />
